Intro to Shellfishing at North Cove

November 14, 2026
2:30 PM

Curious about local shellfishing? Join us at the shoreline to learn the basics!

After check-in, we’ll suit up and start with an on-land demonstration before heading out at low tide to harvest local shellfish together. We provide all the gear you need, including waders, rakes, measuring gauges, and harvest baskets. No license needed!

This is a FREE Bay Adventure offered in partnership with the Town of Fairhaven. Register today to join the fun!

For more information,  
Email: Baptista@savebuzzardsbay.org
